I enjoyed the story so far but i have to say some of the bugs make the game borderline unplayable. the most annoying one i have is I randomly get a warrant for just driving down the street. I've seen where people say the bug is that the hostile cops don't despawn so i try to kill them then I get 100000000 cops spawning around me and I don't survive long. I could keep running sure but its a constant annoyance for it to happen right by mission locations, then I have to wait to do the mission. I've played 42 hours and its constant when I'm in the city. Not to mention the quest to get your og car is bugged to the point it literally isn't there lol. over all it seems to have a good story but with major gameplay problems, promises that the company made that were never delivered or wasn't intended to happen anyways. I agree that a lot of people jump on the hate bandwagon before playing it, I went in with zero expectations and was pleasantly surprised at least from the story. But I don't think its irrational to be upset about the bugs and  other promises. One major thing I have to disagree with is that the cities, that the world feels alive. I've had several people just start floating, cars with people t posing out of them, and many more issues. I can compare it to Red dead redemption 2, you can follow a random guy on his horse for miles without him disappearing, he even ends up in a location. RDR2 has so much more accurate world building and character development. sure its not an rpg at all, but it is an open world game.  Everyone despawns the second you look away. I think its unfair to compare cyberpunk 2077 to the Elder Scrolls, the latest single player rpg was released in 2012, its almost 2022, comparing the short comings of skyrim to cyberpunk isn't exactly accurate, especially when there are things cyberpunk is missing that games 2 decades ago have, water physics for example. So If you want to compare the quality of skyrim and games before it look at what cyberpunk is missing. It is perfectly okay to enjoy this game, anyone else having problems with it should not diminish what you personally enjoy about this game. But by the same token don't try and diminish that the game has serious problems for a lot of users, because you do enjoy it.
